self_dogfood.requirement: Optimize tiny-review-router so requests to create a code-review Skill first locate existing review capability and defer final operation to SR-F1.

co_created_baseline.real_scenario: A user says they want to create a code-review Skill, but an existing review capability may already cover the need.
co_created_baseline.business_constraint: The run must prove the complete skill-refiner flow without installing runtime copies or running the full slow suite.

co_created_baseline.observed_pain: The input Skill makes an immediate final decision to create a new code-review Skill before checking existing review capability.
co_created_baseline.protected_capability_candidate: Keep a tiny router Skill that still helps with code-review Skill requests.
co_created_baseline.entry_point_candidate: Trigger and Flow, because the wrong behavior starts at premature routing and final operation timing.
co_created_baseline.open_questions: No open questions for this self-run fixture; user asked Codex to self-run a small complete flow.

problem_cards.next_cut_reason: The fixture's highest leverage defect is the premature create decision because it breaks the user's expected route-before-create behavior before later rings can help.
problem_cards.phenomenon: Input Skill decides to create a code-review Skill before checking existing review capability.
problem_cards.why_problem: A final create operation before capability lookup can duplicate an existing Skill and bypass SR-F1 final operation freeze.
problem_cards.impact: Agent, user, existing review Skill, and final operation gate.
problem_cards.target_shape: Output first locates existing review capability, records creation only as a candidate, and freezes final_operation=optimize at SR-F1.
problem_cards.signal_source: Self-dogfood small requirement designed to exercise final operation freeze.
problem_cards.counter_evidence: If no existing review capability could be searched or the request explicitly required a new Skill, this would return to SR-S2/SR-R1 for user confirmation.
problem_cards.stop_condition: Stop if capability routing changes the fixture scope beyond the tiny router or requires runtime installation.
